title: Martians built the moon as a transport and terraforming device

tellings.quote: the people on Mars probably constructed the moon for two purposes.

plain: People living on Mars probably built the Moon, and they built it for two purposes: as a means of transport and as a device for making Earth fit to live on. The philosopher Jason Jorjani puts this forward on the show, drawing on Joe McMoneagle, a remote viewer (someone said to describe distant places by mind alone), and on a work he credits called Closer Encounters.
